children: Citi Research initiated coverage of Versant
with a Buy rating to reflect a favorable 2:1 risk reward and a possible decision to drop English Premier League (EPL) rights that could provide $8 of upside to the company’s share price.

existing agreement with EPL (inherited from NBCUniversal) runs through the 2027-2028 season. CEO Mark Lazarus has noted that increased costs to broadcast NFL games could force the company to reconsider its EPL contract when it comes up for bid.
“Dropping EPL is a positive catalyst,” said Citi analyst Jason Bazinet. “Given recent deals with
and PAC-12, we see USA Network’s affiliate fees as durable without EPL.”
The decision whether to continue with EPL could occur as soon as the second quarter of 2027 (one year prior to expiration) and as late as Q2 2028 (contract expiration).
Bazinet assigns a $41 price target to Versant
, representing 24% upside to Wednesday’s closing price and was derived from 4.5x 2027 EV/EBITDA.
Shares are higher for the first time in six days.
